paragraphs.text: translated by
1. IN the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created beings.
paragraphs.original: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत् ।
paragraphs.translit: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt |

paragraphs.text: He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 2. Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandments all the Gods acknowledge -.
paragraphs.original: य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 3. Who by his grandeur hath become Sole Ruler of all the moving world that breathes and slumbers;
paragraphs.original: यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव ।
paragraphs.translit: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva |

paragraphs.text: He who is Lord of men and Lord of cattle. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 4. His, through his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasa his possession:
paragraphs.original: यस्येमे हिमवन्तो महित्वा यस्य समुद्रं रसया सहाहुः ।
paragraphs.translit: yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ |

paragraphs.text: His arms are these, his are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 5. By him the heavens are strong and earth is steadfast, by him light's realm and sky-vault are supported:
paragraphs.original: येन द्यौरुग्रा पृथिवी च दृळ्हा येन स्वः स्तभितं येन नाकः ।
paragraphs.translit: yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḷhā yena svaḥ stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ |

paragraphs.text: By him the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: यो अन्तरिक्षे रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 6. To him, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit,
paragraphs.original: यं क्रन्दसी अवसा तस्तभाने अभ्यैक्षेतां मनसा रेजमाने ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne |

paragraphs.text: When over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: यत्राधि सूर उदितो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 7. What time the mighty waters came, containing the universal germ, producing Agni,
paragraphs.original: आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्विश्वमायन्गर्भं दधाना जनयन्तीरग्निम् ।
paragraphs.translit: āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyangarbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim |

paragraphs.text: Thence sprang the Gods' one spirit into being. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: ततो देवानां समवर्ततासुरेकः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 8. He in his might surveyed the floods containing productive force and generating Worship.
paragraphs.original: यश्चिदापो महिना पर्यपश्यद्दक्षं दधाना जनयन्तीर्यज्ञम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam |

paragraphs.text: He is the God of gods, and none beside him. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: यो देवेष्वधि देव एक आसीत्कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsītkasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 9. Neer may he harm us who is earth's Begetter, nor he whose laws are sure, the heavens' Creator,
paragraphs.original: मा नो हिंसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा जजान ।
paragraphs.translit: mā no hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jajāna |

paragraphs.text: He who brought forth the great and lucid waters. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
paragraphs.original: यश्चापश्चन्द्रा बृहतीर्जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: yaścāpaścandrā bṛhatīrjajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema

paragraphs.text: 10. Prajapati! thou only comprehendest all these created things, and none beside thee.
paragraphs.original: प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव ।
paragraphs.translit: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva |

paragraphs.text: Grant us our hearts' desire when we invoke thee: may we have store of riches in possession.
paragraphs.original: यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्
paragraphs.translit: yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
